problem:
The matrix $R$ is given below. Let ${r}_{1}$, ${r}_{2}$,  ${r}_{3}$ and ${r}_{4}$ be the respective columns of $R.$
Determine if 
$B=\text{{}{r}_{1},{r}_{2},{r}_{3}\text{}}$ is a basis of $\text{Col}(R).$ 
If that is the case, find ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\cdot {x}_{3}$, where ${r}_{4}={x}_{1}{r}_{1}+{x}_{2}{r}_{2}+{x}_{3}{r}_{3}.$ 

$$
R=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & -2 & 1 & -3 \\ 12 & -6 & 6 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Finding a Basis of the Column Space of a Matrix
